system.description:
At 8th level, the persona you built for yourself at 3rd level increases, becoming ever more widely known. You gain a +1 bonus to your prestige rating and choose one of the following options:

Dramatic Persona: By telling grand tales of your escapades, and those of your allies, you are able to use your flair for the dramatic to improve your social standing. If you spend 1 minute or more telling at least one story of your deeds, you gain expertise on persuasion, deception, or intimidation checks among those who heard the tale for the next hour, chosen when you tell the story. Alternatively, if you spend at least an hour telling tales, you may expend 1 exertion point to treat the community you are in as your prestige center for 1 week.

Inspirational: Whether through carefully crafted speeches or a few meaningful words you are able to inspire others to greatness. By using your bonus action and expending 1 exertion, you grant a creature one of the following benefits: inspiration, expertise on a chosen skill or ability check for 1 minute, or you may improve their attitude by one step for 1 minute if they are not engaged in combat. Creatures can only benefit from this once per long rest.

Iron Mask: Your stoicism has become a thing of legend. Insight checks against you are made with disadvantage. In addition, when you fail a saving throw against any mind-affecting effect, you may expend your reaction to automatically succeed the saving throw.
